2181. Reverse Words in a String Using Pointers

90

Hard

Given a sentence containing multiple words separated by spaces, reverse the order of the words using pointers.

The characters within each word must remain unchanged.

Your program should:

Read a complete sentence.

Pass the sentence address to a function named  reverseWords() .

Reverse the entire sentence using pointers.

Reverse each individual word to restore its original character order.

Print the resulting sentence.
input_spec: A single line containing a sentence.
